# Zanovo

> Cape Town web design and AI systems agency. We help small businesses capture leads, close clients, and operate 24/7 — even after hours.

Zanovo builds custom websites and AI-powered systems for small businesses in Cape Town, South Africa. Our focus is on helping businesses get found online, capture more leads, and close clients automatically — even outside business hours.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://zanovo.co.za/): Custom, fast-loading websites built for local SEO and lead generation.
- [AI Lead Generation Systems](https://zanovo.co.za/): Automated systems that capture enquiries from web, WhatsApp, and social media 24/7.
- [AI Automation](https://zanovo.co.za/): Custom AI workflows for client onboarding, follow-up, CRM integration, and appointment booking.
